headline.zh: 进门玩‘石头剪子布蜥蜴斯波克’点单

traits.zh: 咖啡种类不少，按季节上新当季特饮
traits.en: Multiple coffee options with seasonal specials

traits.zh: 店面不大但收拾得挺干净
店内有白色沙发和木制桌椅
traits.en: White sofas and wooden tables and chairs

traits.zh: 室内天花板有工业风管道和长条灯
traits.en: Industrial-style ceiling pipes and linear lights

traits.zh: 老板林明旺是数学系毕业的理工男
traits.en: Owner Lin Mingwang is a math graduate and engineer

focus.zh: 店面不大但干净，未提办公设施
focus.en: Small clean space, no work setup mentioned

linger.zh: 有沙发和桌椅，空间小但整洁
linger.en: Sofas and chairs in small clean space
